verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge stores agent-writable pages in nested scopes, and the docs say links between pages make it a graph rather than a list of documents; Studio visualizes how pages link. That is a page-level link graph, though, not an entity/relationship model, and there is no evidence of graph-traversal querying for multi-hop answers. missing for 10: entity extraction or entity-typed nodes, typed relationships between entities, multi-hop/graph traversal queries, entity-centric retrieval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable

citations.quote: These links make Knowledge a graph rather than a list of documents.
shows every scope and page as a tree beside a graph of how the pages link
With Knowledge, an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time.
